candidate.text: Features: * AMI Selector Terms has a new Alias field which can only be set by itself in `EC2NodeClass.Spec.AMISelectorTerms` * Disruption Budgets by Reason was added to `NodePool.Spec.Disruption.Budgets` * TerminationGracePeriod was added to `NodePool.Spec.Template.Spec`. * LOG_OUTPUT_PATHS and LOG_ERROR_OUTPUT_PATHS environment variables added

evidence.excerpt:
* Features:
  * AMI Selector Terms has a new Alias field which can only be set by itself in `EC2NodeClass.Spec.AMISelectorTerms`
  * Disruption Budgets by Reason was added to `NodePool.Spec.Disruption.Budgets`
  * TerminationGracePeriod was added to `NodePool.Spec.Template.Spec`.
  * LOG_OUTPUT_PATHS and LOG_ERROR_OUTPUT_PATHS environment variables added
